evidence.name: Screen field: How far the fade extends
evidence.userNeed: Know what "How far the fade extends" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: How far the fade extends
sections.description: Controls how far the fade reaches across the media (0 to 100%). Match it to where your text or button sits: if the copy is near the bottom, a 30 to 50% fade from that edge usually gives enough contrast without darkening the whole image. Increase it if text is still hard to read, decrease it to show more of the image clearly.
